summary: PHP (Slim) backend for KNS Group's real-estate CRM/ERP, covering leads, bookings, payments and legal documents.
highlights: Integrated Meta Lead Ads webhooks and Google APIs into a real-time lead pipeline, cutting lead processing time by 40%.
Added Redis caching to high-traffic CRM endpoints and removed N+1 queries using ROW_NUMBER() window functions, improving response times by 30%.

Built a payment-receipt allocation engine (FIFO across milestones) with row-level locking (SELECT … FOR UPDATE) to prevent double allocation, plus cron-based payment reminders and bank-specific demand notes.
Built an Exotel VoIP calling microservice with webhook handlers and owner-aware call routing (round-robin fallback), enabling in-app calling for the sales team.
Integrated Microsoft Graph API to generate Word documents and store versioned PDFs in OneDrive, automating booking and legal document workflows.

Delivered workflow modules (bulk lead transfer, construction-linked payment plans with versioned amendments, e-stamp and legal file requests) with RBAC via Repository/Service patterns, status tracking and audit logs.
